title: Speed up a test suite without shrinking it
question: How do I let an agent make my tests faster without letting it delete the slow ones?
teaches: protecting a property of the run (test count) instead of hashing files
an acceptance check the agent cannot edit, behind editable unit tests
wall-clock is not inherently noisy: this suite measured 0.1% spread

recorded.agent: claude CLI, headless, with labloop-proposer skill installed
